status_note: Audit findings distinguish confirmed test observations from product defects. Failed assertions with stale-or-unknown expectations are not classified as confirmed application defects.

issues.description: Dashboard rules contain hard-coded white and pale light-theme surfaces. The persisted customer theme has dark tokens, but partner workspace theme applicability and rendered appearance were not verified.
evidence: Authenticated fixture rendered an auth/backend error; no valid dashboard theme screenshot
reproduction_steps: Open an authenticated partner workspace with a valid local fixture
Toggle/persist the supported theme if partner workspaces inherit it
Inspect dashboard surfaces and text contrast
issues.expected_result: Surfaces and text follow the documented theme contract with readable contrast.
issues.actual_result: Not established in a valid rendered partner workspace.
issues.root_cause: Hard-coded light values confirmed; user-visible impact/theme contract unknown.
issues.recommended_fix: After confirming partner theme support, replace applicable fixed colors with semantic tokens and verify all roles; otherwise document the intentional light-only contract.

issues.description: Responsive browser test passes welcome/customer-home dimensions, then exits on `Explore navigation missing`. This alone does not establish whether the app or test expectation is wrong.
evidence: Executed node scripts/responsive-browser-test.cjs; prior listed viewports passed; assertion failed at Explore navigation
reproduction_steps: Inspect the failing route, DOM and current navigation contract
issues.expected_result: Test and current route agree on the intended Explore navigation behavior.
issues.actual_result: Assertion fails; product regression versus stale selector/expectation unresolved.
issues.recommended_fix: Reconcile the test assertion with current app navigation and repair only a confirmed regression.

issues.description: Browser fixture assertion expects a Verify mobile card for an email/Google account but receives null. Product flow versus stale expectation is unresolved.
evidence: Executed node scripts/service-partner-verify-mobile-browser-test.cjs; assertion `Email/Google account sees the Verify mobile card` failed
reproduction_steps: Run the browser test with its configured fixture
Inspect current auth method and mobile verification policy
issues.expected_result: The current product policy is reflected in the UI and test expectation.
issues.actual_result: Expected card not present in fixture.
issues.recommended_fix: Confirm intended verification requirement and update either the flow or stale assertion, then retest the journey.

issues.description: Browser test cannot find expected first-service guidance. This may be a regression or a stale selector/fixture expectation.
evidence: Executed node scripts/service-posting-browser-test.cjs; `First-service guidance appears` assertion failed
reproduction_steps: Inspect first-service empty state for the active account fixture
issues.expected_result: A new/empty service-posting state provides the intended guidance and next action.
issues.actual_result: Test did not find expected guidance.
issues.recommended_fix: Verify the real empty state and update the product or test only after confirming the intended behavior.

issues.description: Authenticated partner dashboard verification is blocked because the local fixture rendered an auth/backend error; available partner dashboard/navigation tests also fail later assertions on route/status expectations.
evidence: Partner browser checks failed later route/status assertions
reproduction_steps: Run partner dashboard and navigation browser checks for Professional, Influencer, and Consultant
issues.expected_result: Each permitted partner role reaches its intended dashboard and actions work.
issues.actual_result: No valid authenticated dashboard state available for this audit.
issues.root_cause: Fixture/auth/backend state and test expectation alignment unresolved.
issues.recommended_fix: Repair fixture/environment and reconcile route/status expectations; then run and capture role-specific journeys.

issues.description: Existing model test reports a demo amount discrepancy: markup 25,000 versus SQL 12,000. Business intent and expected source of truth require confirmation.
evidence: Recorded test result: partner-demo-model-test.cjs mismatch, markup 25,000 vs SQL 12,000
reproduction_steps: Compare UI fixture and SQL seed values with approved demo contract
issues.expected_result: Fixture and seed values agree with the approved demo contract.
issues.root_cause: Unknown until product data source of truth is confirmed.
issues.recommended_fix: Confirm approved value and align fixture/seed; do not infer business value from one side.
